build_maxvit_model: build a MaxViT model with block-like and grid-like attention for image classification
create_attention_module: create a windowed self-attention module with relative positional bias for MaxViT blocks
create_mbconv_block: create an MBConv block with SqueezeExcitation and depthwise convolutions
create_feedforward_layer: create a FeedForward layer with LayerNorm, GELU, and dropout for transformer blocks
test_maxvit_forward: test the MaxViT forward pass on a batch of image tensors for classification
